from haldane import calc_hamiltonian
import numpy as np

# Test with simple parameters
kx, ky = 0.0, 0.0
a = 1.0
t1 = 1.0
t2 = 0.3
phi = 0.0
m = 0.0

H = calc_hamiltonian(kx, ky, a, t1, t2, phi, m)
print("Hamiltonian at Gamma point (0,0):")
print(H)

# Test with non-zero k
kx, ky = 0.1, 0.2
H2 = calc_hamiltonian(kx, ky, a, t1, t2, phi, m)
print("\nHamiltonian at (0.1, 0.2):")
print(H2)

# Test with phi != 0
phi = pi/3
H3 = calc_hamiltonian(0.0, 0.0, a, t1, t2, phi, m)
print("\nHamiltonian at Gamma point with phi=pi/3:")
print(H3)

# Verify the matrix shape
assert H.shape == (2, 2), f"Expected shape (2, 2), got {H.shape}"
assert H.dtype == complex, f"Expected complex dtype, got {H.dtype}"
print("\nAll tests passed!")
